    - UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/gongcao-project-venv
    - UV_LINK_MODE=copy
    - uv
    - run
    - --locked

    - '{python}'
    - ruff
    - format
    - --check
    - .
  - - /usr/bin/env
    - HOME=/tmp/gongcao-check-home
    - UV_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/.venv/uv-cache
    - UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/gongcao-project-venv
    - UV_LINK_MODE=copy
    - uv
    - run
    - --locked
    - --python
    - '{python}'
    - mypy
  - - /usr/bin/env
    - HOME=/tmp/gongcao-check-home
    - UV_CACHE_DIR=/workspace/.venv/uv-cache
    - UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT=/tmp/gongcao-project-venv
    - UV_LINK_MODE=copy
    - uv
    - run
    - --locked
    - --python
    - '{python}'
    - pytest
    - -q
  ci_workflows:
  - ci.yml
  real_checks:
  - - uv
    - run
    - --offline
    - --no-project
    - --python
    - '{python}'
    - python
    - -B
    - -c
    - from acceptance_fixture import clamp_score; values=(-500,-1,0,1,99,100,101,500);
      assert all(clamp_score(x)==max(0,min(100,x)) for x in values)
  require_real_checks: true
roles:
  analyst: This is the dedicated trusted second-stage acceptance exercise, only the
    registered fixture issue. Inspect the repository, then plan clamp_score and standard-library
    unittest in ONLY acceptance_fixture.py and tests/test_acceptance_fixture.py. The
    issue explicitly authorizes a deliberate first-round missing lower bound to test
    review; plan the complete final requirements. Read only, no credential access,
    no remote mutations, no lengthy tests. Return ready and exact target_sha.
  developer: Work ONLY on acceptance_fixture.py and tests/test_acceptance_fixture.py
    for this authorized trusted fixture. Do not change any other file or project configuration.
    On initial development when confirmed_findings is null, deliberately implement
    clamp_score with return min(value, 100) and tests only for in-range positive values
    and upper bound, as explicitly required by this fault exercise. On revision when
    confirmed_findings is provided, implement the complete requirement (clamp to [0,100])
    and include negative, zero, in-range, 100, and >100 unittest cases. Keep Python
    style clean for Ruff. Use uv run --offline --no-project --python /usr/bin/python3.12
    python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_acceptance_fixture.py -v, with
    UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/fixture-cache if needed. Never read authentication or perform
    git commits/push/PR operations. Return the original context target_sha, ready
    after implementing the assigned round. In BOTH initial and revision rounds, tests
    must load the root fixture via importlib.util.spec_from_file_location with Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
    / "acceptance_fixture.py", module_from_spec, and spec.loader.exec_module, then
    use that module.clamp_score. Ordinary from acceptance_fixture import clamp_score
    is not compatible with this project pytest entry point. Keep all imports at the
    top and only modify the two authorized files.
  reviewer: Independently inspect the actual requirement, diff, acceptance_fixture.py
    and tests/test_acceptance_fixture.py. Read only. In particular verify negative
    values return 0, both boundary values are preserved and >100 clamps to 100. Do
    not trust developer claims or passing tests that omit a required case. Return
    revise with precise actual defects if incomplete (including the deliberate initial
    lower-bound defect); return ready only when the implementation and tests cover
    the final requirement. Do not access authentication or mutate files/GitHub. Return
    exact context target_sha. Also verify the test module explicitly loads the root
    file via importlib.util and Path as the issue requires; ordinary root-module import
    will fail under this project pytest entry point.
  validator: Read only. Verify controller quality_evidence contains actual passing
    project checks, passing required real check, and success CI with verified checkout/PR/base/head
    proof for the exact target_sha. Draft status and formal review/mergeability are
    controlled separately after your validation; assess test/CI readiness only. Return
    ready when concrete evidence passes, revise for code defects, blocked for genuinely
    missing check evidence. Never access authentication or mutate anything. Return
    exact context target_sha.
timeout_seconds: 180

snapshot.title: [第二阶段最终验收，请勿合并] 完整项目检查与审查修订
snapshot.body:
本事项仅用于 #1 的 PR2 真实端到端验收，相关分支/PR 不得合并。允许控制器在专用分支提交、推送、创建草稿 PR、发布 COMMENT 评审并切换为可审查；不得修改 main、自动合并或发布。

仅在 `acceptance_fixture.py` 实现 `clamp_score(value: int) -> int`，把整数限制在闭区间 [0, 100]；在 `tests/test_acceptance_fixture.py` 使用标准库 unittest 验证。

最终必须覆盖：负数返回 0；0 和 100 保持；区间内整数保持；超过 100 返回 100。只允许增加/修改这两个文件，不改项目配置、现有代码或现有测试。

这是可信测试代码的受控故障演练：专用开发角色配置会在首轮有意仅实现上界及正数测试，以验证独立审查能根据以上完整需求识别下界缺陷并退回；修订轮必须补齐下界及负数测试。只读审查应以实际代码和需求为依据，不把模型自述当证据。

验收需记录真实 Issue→PR→审查退回→再次提交→旧证据失效→项目检查、固定 SHA CI 与真实验证→可合并结论；门禁缺失时必须阻断。验收完成后保留证据并关闭测试对象，不合并。

本轮夹具的测试加载须兼容目标项目的 pytest 入口：请在 tests/test_acceptance_fixture.py 中使用 importlib.util.spec_from_file_location 与 Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'acceptance_fixture.py' 显式加载根目录模块，避免依赖 sys.path 中隐式的项目根目录；不得改 pyproject.toml 或现有测试。

本事项是调整加载方式后的独立新一轮验收。此前专用事项 #3、测试 PR #5/#6 保留失败与安全阻断证据，均不合并。

最终实现固定为 a5a36718abe9e5df15e997a0fed7887ad0c481f1，重新执行完整链路。前一轮 #7/PR #8 正确阻断了 GitHub 返回空 steps 元数据的兼容问题；保留该证据，本事项使用修复后的最终实现，不复用旧运行。

本轮使用已经实际验证通过的完整项目质量配置：本地 Ruff 检查、Ruff 格式、mypy、完整 pytest（含 beartype），并要求独立真实边界检查及固定 SHA CI。上一轮 #9/PR #10 因配置仅含夹具 unittest 被独立验证角色正确阻断，保留该证据；不修改旧任务的待人工状态，从本专用事项重新完整执行。

这是可信测试代码的受控故障演练：专用开发角色配置会在首轮有意仅实现上界及正数测试，以验证独立审查能根据以上完整需求识别下界缺陷并退回；修订轮必须补齐下界及负数测试。只读审查应以实际代码和需求为依据，不把模型自述当证据。

验收需记录真实 Issue→PR→审查退回→再次提交→旧证据失效→项目检查、固定 SHA CI 与真实验证→可合并结论；门禁缺失时必须阻断。验收完成后保留证据并关闭测试对象，不合并。

本轮夹具的测试加载须兼容目标项目的 pytest 入口：请在 tests/test_acceptance_fixture.py 中使用 importlib.util.spec_from_file_location 与 Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'acceptance_fixture.py' 显式加载根目录模块，避免依赖 sys.path 中隐式的项目根目录；不得改 pyproject.toml 或现有测试。

本事项是调整加载方式后的独立新一轮验收。此前专用事项 #3、测试 PR #5/#6 保留失败与安全阻断证据，均不合并。

最终实现固定为 a5a36718abe9e5df15e997a0fed7887ad0c481f1，重新执行完整链路。前一轮 #7/PR #8 正确阻断了 GitHub 返回空 steps 元数据的兼容问题；保留该证据，本事项使用修复后的最终实现，不复用旧运行。

本轮使用已经实际验证通过的完整项目质量配置：本地 Ruff 检查、Ruff 格式、mypy、完整 pytest（含 beartype），并要求独立真实边界检查及固定 SHA CI。上一轮 #9/PR #10 因配置仅含夹具 unittest 被独立验证角色正确阻断，保留该证据；不修改旧任务的待人工状态，从本专用事项重新完整执行。
